tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Paris Masters Day 5 Wednesday stacks 14 round-of-32 matches on indoor hard, headlined by Zverev–Musetti, Djokovic–Hijikata and Alcaraz–Michelsen on Court Central • [SQUASH] PSA Platinum U.S. Open quarterfinals open Wednesday in Philadelphia with Mostafa Asal–Joel Makin and Amina Orfi–Sivasangari Subramaniam after ElShorbagy’s upset of Zakaria • [BADMINTON] Yeosu Victor Korea Open Super 500 main draw rolls at Jinnam Stadium as world No. 1 An Se Young continues her home title push after Monday qualifying • [PICKLEBALL] Opendoor PPA Worlds moves to Round of 32 Wednesday at Brookhaven with 11 a.m. CT first serve across five pro divisions on PickleballTV • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Frankfurt Day 2 at Süwag Energie Arena sends 13 more round-of-32 singles through day and night sessions, including Ovtcharov–Assar and Hayata–Zhang

newsItems.title: Korea Open Main Draw
newsItems.excerpt: Super 500 play continues in Yeosu as An Se Young and defending doubles champions Kim Won Ho and Seo Seung Jae lead the field at Jinnam Stadium.

newsItems.title: Worlds Round of 32
newsItems.excerpt: Brookhaven hosts PPA Worlds main-draw Wednesday with Round of 32 action at 11 a.m. CT as the 3,000-point major narrows the pro fields.

newsItems.title: Frankfurt R32 Day 2
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Frankfurt schedules 13 singles round-of-32 matches Wednesday, pairing home hope Ovtcharov with Assar and Hayata with American Lily Zhang.

newsItems.title: Paris Round of 32
newsItems.excerpt: Shelton and Ruud advanced Tuesday; Wednesday’s slate adds Zverev–Musetti, Medvedev–Buse and Fils–Machac as the Masters 1000 field hits the last 32.
